name: Al Jazibiah beauty saloon
address: Malaka street - Hay Al Nahda - Sharjah - United Arab Emirates
owner_description: Al Jazibiah Beauty Salon is a ladies’ salon in Al Nahda, Sharjah, with over 20 years of experience in beauty and personal care. Our experienced team specialises in hair colouring, keratin and hair botox treatments, alongside nail care, facials, lymphatic facial massage, relaxing body massages and traditional Moroccan baths. Whether you are refreshing your look or enjoying time for yourself, we offer personalised attention in a welcoming, comfortable setting. We are dedicated to helping every client leave feeling confident, refreshed and beautifully cared for.

reviews.author: Veena Narayan
reviews.text:
I have visited Al Jazibiyah Salon many times, and I have always had a wonderful experience. The staff are very friendly, welcoming, and accommodating, and the salon is always clean and well maintained. I have been extremely satisfied with all the services I have received so far.
Ms. Era is highly experienced in facials, and every treatment with her is so relaxing and comfortable. She takes the time to understand your skin and recommends what is best for you. She performs every treatment with great care, dedication, and attention to detail.

I would also like to mention Ms. Josie, who is very friendly, caring, and professional. She is highly experienced in protein treatments and hair styling, and she always does an excellent job.

Both Ms. Era and Ms. Josie consistently deliver excellent results, and I am always happy with their services. I will definitely continue visiting Al Jazibiyah Salon regularly and highly recommend it to anyone looking for professional, caring, and quality salon services.
reviews.owner_reply:
Thank you so much for your wonderful and detailed review! ❤️✨
